alexcrichton opened PR #14825 from alexcrichton:enqueue-less to bytecodealliance:main:

This commit fixes an error in the embedding API where call_async could return an error but the guest would actually go ahead and keep running on the next run_concurrent. The fix here is to more eagerly check for event loop reentrance to prevent anything from being enqueued in the first place.
